Title: App Service support for Java 11 (Linux and Windows) is now available

Body.Content:
App Service now supports Java 11, expanding the language support to the two latest LTS versions of the Java runtime. This allows you to run your Java apps without incurring unplanned Java SE subscription fees, all while enjoying free security patches and platform bug fixes. Java 11 support is provided on both Linux and Windows versions of App Service and is now available to the public.
